notes.title: Bloody Pixel Games Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends! Last year was very difficult not only for our small team, but also for our country - Ukraine. There may still be those who will say that games should be out of politics, but it's hard not to talk about it when you have russian missiles flying over your head. Many of us were forced to leave our homes, all because of russia's insidious attack on Ukraine on February 24, 2022. For almost a year now, we have been living under constant shelling, interruptions in electricity and communications have become commonplace, despite all this, we continue to work and help each other. Many projects that we planned to make in 2022 had to be frozen and we began to outsource and collaborate with other developers. 
Today we are finally release Paranoia Place in early access, we really hope that this project will catch your attention, and give us the opportunity to continue doing what we love so much. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592290/PARANOIA_PLACE/

Despite the impossibility of predicting the near future, we look at the world with hope and faith in the victory of our country, our people and the entire civilized world over tyranny. We have big plans and hopes for the development of this project, and we are also looking forward to expanding our team and getting back to work on our other announced and unannounced games. We are waiting for your feedback, reactions and emotions. 

Thanks to everyone who has been supporting us all this time, peace to all and Glory to Ukraine!

notes.title: SUPPORT UKRAINE
notes.notes:
Dear friends, brothers and sisters. We apologize for not getting in touch earlier. We needed time to take care of our families and each other. We are a very small independent game development team from Ukraine. On February 24, 2022, Russia attacked Ukraine. There are no simple words to convey the horrors that happen in our country at this very moment.

We planned to release a global update for Eternal Blood in the next month, as well as release a new game Paranoia Place. However, due to the current terrible events, we do not know when we will be able to return to a normal lifestyle.

The invasion of Ukraine is evidence of the potential impact on the world - this is far bigger than one country and the stakes are high for every nation and individual. Rise up for global rights and International law. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Here we go! SILENT DOOM & ETERNAL BLOOD - What's next?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! What a hell of a year ..)) A lot of things went absolutely not according to the plan, but we didn't stop despite all the obstacles and now we are ready to bring to you ETERNAL BLOOD a fast-paced, challenging arena shooter. This project was made by the most part only by two people investing their free time from the main work. For those who are not with us from the beginning i like to say - don't worry, SILENT DOOM was all that time in development but not at the full time because of the lack of investments. With your support for this project, we will had an opportunity to expand our team and fully return to the development of SILENT DOOM. More updates will come in the next few weeks! Thank you all! See you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1218940/ETERNAL_BLOOD/

notes.title: SILENT DOOM - First Trailer + important announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Good news! The first SILENT DOOM trailer is here, not very good news,
a few weeks ago, we redirected our forces to another project. The reason behind this is simple - lack of resources. At first, we thought about creating a kickstarter campaing, however, according to our calculations, preparation for such event would take us in around 4-6 months - instead, we decided to create another project, that can be easier to develop in a short time and still will have a strong core. This decision will help us continue to be independent and continuing to make what we love. ETERNAL BLOOD will be ready to play at Q2 2020 by that time we plan to expand our team which will allows us to fully return to the development of SILENT DOOM. Stay with us, here we are working to bring some really unique gaming experiences. See you soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1218940/ETERNAL_BLOOD/
